content: Tamesɣiwt n yeyyar
Awař nni dd-iffɣen zi SIDI ɣar Irmiya deg useggʷas wiss ɛecra n Ṣidqiya, ajeǧid n Yahuda. Aseggʷas-a tuɣa d aseggʷas wiss tmenṭac n Nabuxadraṣṣar.
Deg wussan nni tuɣa řɛeskar n ujeǧid n Babil iḥeṣṣar-dd Urcalim uca anabi Irmiya tuɣa ittwaḥebbes di řemraḥ n řeḥbes nni tuɣa di taddart n ujeǧid n Yahuda.
Maɣar tuɣa iḥebbes i-t Ṣidqiya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, am d as inna: “Mayemmi tᵉttnabbed, teqqared: ‘Ammu i iqqar SIDI: Xzar, Necc ad ggeɣ tandint-a deg ufus n ujeǧid n Babil u netta ad tt tᵉṭṭef.
Ṣidqiya, ajeǧid n Yahuda, war inejjem zeg ufus n Ikaldaniyyen, maca ad immewc deg ufus n ujeǧid n Babil. Netta ad kides issiweř zeg uqemmum ɣar uqemmum u netta ad t iẓar tiṭṭ di tiṭṭ.
Netta ad yawi Ṣidqiya ɣar Babil u netta ad dinni iqqim, ař ɣares i ɣa raḥeɣ, ammu i iqqar SIDI. Waxxa kenniw ad temmenɣem ak-d Ikaldaniyyen, war ttikkwiḍem ca.’”
Irmiya inna: “Yusa-dd ɣari wawař n SIDI, inna:
‘Xzar, Ḥanam’il, mmis n ɛemmic Callum, ad ɣarek dd-yas uca ad yini: Seɣ i yixef nnec iyyar inu di Ɛanatut, maɣar cek ɣarek řḥeqq n řefdiyyet maḥend ad t tesɣid.’”

Xenni yusa-dd ɣari Ḥanam’il, mmis n ɛemmi, ɛlaḥsab awař n SIDI, di řemraḥ n řeḥbes, inna ayi: “Seɣ xenni iyyar inu di Ɛanatut, di temmurt n Binyamin, maɣar cek ɣarek řḥeqq ad t twarted uca ɣarek řḥeqq n usufeɣ maḥend ad t tefdid, ad t tesɣed.” Řexdenni ssneɣ illa awař-a yusa-dd zi SIDI.
Ammu i sɣiɣ iyyar nni iǧan di Ɛanatut x Ḥanam’il, mmis n ɛemmi, uca wezneɣ as nnuqart: sbeɛṭac ciqlu n nnuqart.
Necc weqqɛeɣ x tabrat, cemmɛeɣ tt uca jjiɣ cchud ad tt ssmetnen uca wezneɣ nnuqart di řmizan.
Ksiɣ tabrat ittwannḍen n tmesɣiwt, tenni tuɣa ittwacemmɛen, ittwari dayes mammec ittwagg řɛahd u min ǧant lfarayiḍ, uřa tabrat yarezmen

uca wciɣ tabrat ittwanḍen n tmesɣiwt i Barux, mmis n Niri-Yah, mmis n Maḥsiya, zzat i tiṭṭawin n Ḥanam’il, mmis n ɛemmi, u zzat i tiṭṭawin n řechud nni tuɣa iweqqɛen tabrat ittwannḍen n tmesɣiwt zzat i tiṭṭawin n marra Wudayen nni iqqimen di řemraḥ n řeḥbes.
Necc umureɣ Barux zzat i tiṭṭawin nsen, nniɣ:

“Ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, AREBBI n Israil: ‘Ksi tibratin-a, tabrat ittwannḍen n tmesɣiwt, am tenni icemmɛen am tanita, tenni yarezmen, uca ssars i-tent deg ict n řqecɛet n třaxt, maḥend ad qqiment aṭṭas n wussan ḥḍant!’
Maɣar ammu i iqqar SIDI n řɛeskarat, AREBBI n Israil: ‘Ad ttwasɣen ɛawed tudrin d iyyaren d imarjaɛen n uḍiř di temmurt-a.’”
Awarni umi tuɣa wciɣ tabrat n tmesɣiwt i Barux, mmis n Niri-Yah, ẓẓuǧeɣ s řaǧaɣ ɣar SIDI, nniɣ:
“Ax, Sidi inu, SIDI, xzar, Cek teggid ijenwan d tammurt s jjhed nnec ameqqran u s uɣiř nnec isswiẓẓḍen. War xak iwɛar walu.
Cek d wenni iggin tamexsiwt icewwaren i řuřuf uca txeǧṣed řmuɛṣiyyet n ibabaten deg weḥsin n iḥenjiren nsen awarni asen, a Cek Arebbi d ameqqran d ajebbar, wenni umi qqaren: SIDI n řɛeskarat.
Cek d ameqqran n ccwar u tejhed di tmegga, maɣar tiṭṭawin nnec ttɛessent x marra ibriden n tarwa n bnadem, ḥima ad txeǧṣeḍ kuř ijj ɛlaḥsab ibriden nnes u ɛlaḥsab řɣiǧet n tmegga nnes.
Cek teggid řeɛřamat d lmujizat di Miṣra, ař ass-a, am deg Israil am deg iwdan nneɣni. Teggid ijj n Yisem i Yixef nnec, am mammec i teǧa ass-a.
Cek tessuffɣed-dd řgens nnec Israil zi temmurt n Miṣra s řeɛřamat d lmuɛjizat, s ijj n ufus ijehden d ijj n uɣiř isswiẓẓaḍen, umi tessekkared ict n teggʷudi tameqqrant jar řegnus.
Cek tewcid asen tammurt-a, tenni tejjuǧed i řejdud nsen maḥend ad asen tt tewced, ict n temmurt ifeyyḍen s uɣi d tamment.
Nitni udfen-dd ɣares uca ṭṭfen tt d tasɣart, maca nitni war sřin i tmijja nnec u war uyuren deg webrid n Ccariɛa nnec u war ggin ɛlaḥṣab marra minzi ten tweṣṣid. S uya i ten iřqef marra řɣar-a.

Xzar, icbaren i řeḥṣaret! Nitni iwḍen-dd ař tandint maḥend ad tt ṭṭfen, uca tandint temmewc deg ufus n Ikaldaniyyen nni akides ittmenɣan, zi ssibbet n ssif d řaẓ d ṭṭaɛun. Min tessiwřed aqa yiweḍ-dd. Xzar, tᵉttwarid t simant nnec.
Waxxa amenni tennid ayi, a Sidi inu, SIDI: Seɣ i yixef nnec iyyar nni s nnuqart uca ejj řechud ad tt ssmetnen, řami temmewc tendint deg ufus n Ikaldaniyyen.”
Xenni yusa-dd wawař n SIDI ɣar Irmiya, inna:
“Xzar, Necc d SIDI, AREBBI n marra nni ɣarsen arrimet n weysum. Ma iwɛar xafi ca?’
S uya, ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Necc ad ggeɣ tandint-a deg ufus n Ikaldaniyyen u deg ufus n Nabuxadraṣṣar, ajeǧid n Babil, u netta ad tt iṭṭef.

Ikaldaniyyen, inni ittmenɣan ak-d tendint-a, ad ɣares dd-adfen, ad qedden tandint s tmessi uca ad tt sscemḍen ak-d tudrin nni x tzeɣwin nsent i zi qeddmen tiwhibin n řebxur i Baɛl uca seyyben tiwhibin n useyyeb i irebbiten nneɣni ḥima ad ayi sɛaren.
Maɣar ayt n Israil d ayt n Yahuda zi temẓi nsen tteggen mɣir min iǧan d aɛeffan di tiṭṭawin inu. Ayt n Israil sɛaren ayi s řxedmet n ifassen nsen!’, iqqar SIDI.
‘Maɣar tandint tuɣa tt i Necc d ssibbet n weɣḍab d wesɛar zeg wass nni di tᵉttwabna ař ass-a, ařami tt ɣa nḍareɣ x wudem inu
zi ssibbet n marra řɣar n ayt n Israil d ayt n Yahuda maḥend ad ayi sɛaren, nitni d ijeǧiden nsen d řḥukkam nsen d ikehhanen nsen d inabiyyen nsen d iryazen n Yahuda d imezdaɣ n Urcalim.
Nitni wcin ayi-dd s weɛrur, war iǧi s uɣembub, waxxa Necc ssřemdeɣ ten, ɛad zeg umezwaru ssɣareɣ ten, maca nitni war xsen ad sřen maḥend ad ṭṭfen ttarbiyyet.
Nitni ssbedden nnɛawat nsen n l’aṣnam di Taddart i xef ittwabarreḥ Isem inu maḥend ad tt ssxemjen.

Nitni ssbedden řegɛudi n Baɛl mani i d as ttwehhben ddbayeḥ nsen di teɣzurt n mmis n Hinnum maḥend ad sseɛdun iḥenjiren nsen d tḥenjirin nsent i Mulak di tmessi, min war d asen umureɣ ɛemmarṣ u min war d ayi dd-iddaren di řbař inu, aqa ad ggen nnɛi am wa ařami ɛarnen Yahuda ɣar ddnub.’”
“S uya, řexxu, ammu i iqqar SIDI, AREBBI n Israil, x tendint-a i x teqqarem: ‘Aqa temmewc deg ufus n ujeǧid n Babil, s ssif, s řaẓ u s ṭṭaɛun!’:
Xzar, Necc ad ten ssmuneɣ zi marra timmura mani xasen uẓẓřeɣ deg weɣḍab inu u deg wesɛar inu u deg uduqqez n weɣḍab inu, u Necc ad ten arreɣ ɣar wemcan-a u ad ten sszedɣeɣ di řaman.
Nitni ad iřin d řgens inu u Necc ad iřiɣ d AREBBI nsen.
Necc ad asen wceɣ uř d ijj uřa d webrid d ijj ḥima ad ayi ggʷeden marra ussan i tizi nsen u i tizi n iḥenjiren nsen awarni asen.
Necc akidsen ggeɣ ijj n Řɛahd ittduman, aqa war ttḥeyyideɣ zi awarni asen, ḥima ad asen ggeɣ min iṣebḥen, u Necc ad asen ssarseɣ tiggʷudi zzayi deg wuř nsen, maḥend war xafi ttḥeyyiden ɛad.
Necc ad zzaysen farḥeɣ maḥend ad daysen tthilliɣ u zi řmanet inu ad ten ẓẓuɣ di temmurt-a s marra uř inu u s marra řeɛmar inu.’”
“Maɣar ammu i iqqar SIDI: ‘Am mammec i dd iwyeɣ x řgens-a tuɛeffna-ya tameqqrant, ammu i xasen i ɣa ssiwḍeɣ marra taṣebḥant i xasen nniɣ.
Ad sɣen ɛawed iyyaren di temmurt-a i xef teqqarem kenniw: ‘Aqa-tt d ict temmurt ittwareddǧen nhřa bnadem d řmar, temmewc deg ufus n Ikaldaniyyen.’

Ad sɣen ɛawed iyyaren s ttmenyat n nnuqart, ad weqqɛen u ad cemmɛen tibratin n tmesɣiwt, ad awyen řechud ḥima ad ssmetnen tamesɣiwt di temmurt n Binyamin, di jjwayeh n Urcalim, di tneddam n Yahuda, di tneddam n Temmurt n Idurar, di tneddam n Temmurt Iwaṭan u di tneddam n Temmurt n Ljanub, maɣar Necc ad ssenqeřbeɣ tameḥbast nsen, ammu i iqqar SIDI.’”
